title: Digital Storytelling after school
summary: John and his friend hanging during lunch and after school engaging in the craziest collaborative creating writing.They don't realize it but they are engaging in activities that far better align to academic standards than I ever seen.Kids would be living sports 24.7...his choice, not mine. Getting a chance to explore other avenues of making and creativity. #e
author: Greg McVerry
